Interface Task

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Task
A task is any process that may take a long time to run and which can update a status object to reflect its current progress. A task only implements the run(Status) method. A task can be executed by calling its run method directly, but when it is executed using one of the static run methods, it will be executed on a different thread and the status object being updated by the task is periodically printed to System.out at a specified frequency.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

  • Method Details

    • run

      static void run(Task task, Status status, boolean print, int frequency, TimeUnit unit) throws Exception
      Run a task on a separate thread but print its status to System.out at a given frequency. If the status prints an update at least once while it is running, it will also print again when it completes. If the print parameter is true then the status will always print its update when it completes.
      Parameters:
      task - the task to run on a separate thread
      status - the status object the task object will update as it runs
      print - whether the status should print at least one time
      frequency - the number of time units that will pass between printing updates
      unit - the time unit that must pass some number of times between printing updates
      Throws:
      Exception - if an exception occurs while the task is running
